question: Does the multiplayer Supply Pouch WB select its projectile and two named ammunition/healing affectors, and do typed quantity or cadence operands support a loadout comparison with the reviewed Supply Crate?

sourceFacts.fact: Ten direct import references from the three parent roots resolve against the exact hotfix target file/class GUID identities. The WB points to the supply sphere twice and to both named affectors; the sphere points to ProjectileFeature_SupplyPouch and both named affectors; Ability references U_WEP_SupplyPouch, Feature_SupplyPouch, and CUST_WEP_Grenade_SupplyPouch.

The two WB-referenced affector roots contain 46 ammunition and 11 healing typed numeric/Boolean leaves. The raw values are retained below with their field paths; no quantity or cadence roles are assigned.

The PRJ_SimEx_SupplyPouch capture identity was checked, but its route is not linked by the direct references above. The L143 receipt reports 52 raw-checked ammunition scalar leaves across three Supply Crate affectors, with quantity/cadence roles unresolved.

scope.notes: Exactly the five named Head 4892087 hotfix roots were examined. Four direct import children and parent imports needed for the question were followed separately; no additional supply gadgets were scanned.

ammoFindings.name: Affector_Ammunition_AmmoCrate
ammoFindings.conclusion: The root contains two Field_95eed6ac records with 26 primitive numeric or Boolean leaves, each typed and raw-checked. The field hashes have no established quantity or cadence mapping. Its direct import links include DefaultCategorizationTags and U_Gadget_AmmoBox_Affector_Ammo; the imports do not establish runtime selection or reserve-round changes.

ammoFindings.name: Affector_Ammunition_Rifle_AmmoCrate
ammoFindings.conclusion: The root contains 13 primitive numeric or Boolean leaves, each typed and raw-checked. No field role establishes a quantity or cadence. Direct imports include GraniteSharedAmmoSetup and U_Gadget_AmmoBox_Affector_Ammo; the GraniteSharedAmmoSetup hotfix raw was unavailable.

ammoFindings.name: Affector_Ammunition_MG_AmmoCrate
ammoFindings.conclusion: The root contains 13 primitive numeric or Boolean leaves, each typed and raw-checked. No field role establishes a quantity or cadence. Direct imports include GraniteSharedAmmoSetup and U_Gadget_AmmoBox_Affector_Ammo; the GraniteSharedAmmoSetup hotfix raw was unavailable.

inference: The serialized WB and supply-sphere references support direct asset links to the two named affectors and to ProjectileFeature_SupplyPouch. They do not resolve the separate PRJ_SimEx_SupplyPouch route within one hop.
The 57 raw-checked typed scalar leaves remain unnamed operands. Their types and values cannot support a source-backed quantity/cadence comparison without field roles and units.
L143 reached the same quantity/cadence limit for the Supply Crate ammo affectors. With no Analyzer gadget table and no semantic operands, this second support-resupply line supports a drift stop.
unresolved: The exact PRJ_SimEx_SupplyPouch asset is present as a scoped capture, but no verified direct import from SupplyPouch_WB, SupplyPouch_Ability, or PBNS_SupplyPouch_SupplySphere points to that route. PBNS points to ProjectileFeature_SupplyPouch; following that child's imports would exceed the one-hop limit.

The 46 ammunition and 11 healing scalar leaves have raw-verified serialized types and values, but their hashed fields have no established quantity or cadence meaning or units. They cannot be labeled as replenishment amounts or timing values.
The reviewed L143 Supply Crate receipt leaves its 52 ammunition scalar leaves without quantity/cadence meanings. There is no typed semantic comparison between the Pouch operands and Crate operands.
Serialized imports and values do not establish runtime activation, effect composition, reserve-ammunition changes, or healing outcomes.

SupplyPouch_WB, SupplyPouch_Ability, and PBNS_SupplyPouch_SupplySphere are marked decoded-provisional in the hotfix ledger. Positive reference paths listed here passed raw pointer and target-identity checks; no broader absence claim is made from those roots.
siteImpact: No Analyzer loadout values are supported. The site has no gadget data table, the affector fields lack quantity/cadence roles and units, and the exact PRJ_SimEx_SupplyPouch route is unresolved. No Supply Pouch-versus-Supply Crate comparison is proposed; this is the second support-resupply trace and supports stopping the line under drift stop.
